items.source:
Set whether merging should be enabled for this collection,
in case of a 'parent' collection value being present.
items.translation: 设置是否在此集合存在“父”集合值的情况下启用合并。

items.source: Set the default value type name (class name) to be used for this map.
items.translation: 为此 Map 设置默认值类型名称（类名）。

items.source:
Return a new instance containing keys and values extracted from the
given entries. The entries themselves are not stored in the map.
items.translation: 返回一个新实例，其中包含从给定条目中提取的键和值。这些条目本身不会存储在映射中。

items.source: K - the Map's key type
items.translation: K - Map 的键类型

items.source: V - the Map's value type
items.translation: V - Map 的值类型

items.source: entries - Map.Entrys containing the keys and values from which the map is populated
items.translation: entries - 包含用于填充该映射的键和值的 `Map.Entry`

items.translation: 包含指定映射的Map

items.source: The exact type of the object will depend on the configuration mechanism used.
items.translation: 对象的精确类型将取决于所使用的配置机制。

items.source:
The supplied object is considered the parent, and values in
the callee's value set must override those of the supplied object.
items.translation: 提供的对象被视为父对象，调用者的值集中的值必须覆盖提供对象的值。

include runtime bean references (to be resolved into bean objects).
